notes: Fix: spoken amounts lost inside Hindi sentences ("agar 40,000 ya 50,000 rupees … toh kal mujhe 5 lakh rupees" came out as "agar ya rupees … mujhe rupe"). Numbers are now kept, and an amount that may have lost its number is flagged instead of silently missing.

Fix: English words in a stretch the first pass skipped now come from the stock model ("story sells", not "story cells"); a Hindi stretch the Hinglish model skipped is asked again so the first words ("Stories batao") are no longer left out.

New: Hinglish text polish (section 2): one spelling per word (voh, yeh, toh, nahin, tumhaare, theek…), "paanch laakh" → "5 lakh", question marks only for real questions, sentence capitals. Every change is listed and it can be switched off.
New: Hinglish regression suite with measurements (scripts/hinglish_eval.py) and the writing convention in docs/HINGLISH_STYLE.md.
Fix: a stray "null" text under the transcript table (and in other panels) is gone.
